question: Can you help me find an attraction within a 170 kilometers drive from SCL Health Saint Joseph Hospital, Denver, CO?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE ST_DWithin( geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%SCL Health Saint Joseph Hospital%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Denver%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%CO%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 170000 ) AND tourism = 'attraction';

answers.poi_name: Council tree and old Rooney dance hall

answers.description: Outcrop of a 1.4 billion years gap in the geologic record where the 300-million-year old Fountain Formation nonconformably overlies Precambrium Gneiss (1700 Ma).
